articles.title: 64 Rochdale food businesses rated 0 or 1 for hygiene
articles.excerpt: A total of 64 food businesses in Rochdale hold a food hygiene rating of 0 or 1, indicating urgent or major improvements are necessary, according to the Food Standards Agency.
articles.content_html:
A total of 64 food businesses in the Rochdale borough currently hold a food hygiene rating of 0 or 1, according to records from the Food Standards Agency checked on 29 July 2026. Five businesses are rated 0, indicating that urgent improvement is necessary, while 59 are rated 1, where major improvement is necessary.

Among those rated 0 are Yo 1 Stop, a retailer located at 1 Middleton Road, Heywood, and Apple & Pear, a pub at Andover Avenue, Middleton. Both received their ratings following inspections earlier this year. Other businesses rated 0 include Wildbloods of Norden Limited, Knockout Diner, and Frozen Delights and Convenience, all of which are located in Rochdale.

Businesses rated 1 include Davids, a takeaway in Milnrow, and several retailers such as Denehurst Stores and Meanwood Stores in Rochdale. These establishments received their ratings following inspections conducted in June 2026. Other businesses rated 1 include Zam Zam Kitchen, Marland Court, and Asia Mini Market, which also received their ratings in recent months.

The Food Standards Agency regularly inspects food businesses to ensure compliance with hygiene standards, and these ratings are intended to inform consumers about the hygiene practices of local establishments. The ratings serve as a guide for residents and visitors when choosing where to eat or purchase food.

articles.title: Rochdale Weather Forecast: Sunny Intervals Expected This Week
articles.excerpt: Rochdale is set to experience a mix of sunny intervals and rain over the coming days, with temperatures reaching up to 23°C.
articles.content_html:
Rochdale is expected to see a mix of weather conditions this week, with temperatures peaking at 23°C on Wednesday. The forecast indicates sunny intervals, particularly on Wednesday, while rain is likely at various times throughout the week.

Today, the maximum daytime temperature will reach 23°C, with a minimum of 14°C overnight. Rain is forecasted with a 40% chance at 10pm. Winds will be moderate, with gusts up to 20mph from the west.

On Thursday, temperatures will drop to a maximum of 19°C, with a 20% chance of rain early in the morning. Similar conditions are expected on Friday, with temperatures remaining around 19°C and a 30% chance of rain at 10am.

The weekend looks slightly warmer, with temperatures rising to 21°C on Sunday, but rain is still a possibility. Residents should prepare for variable weather conditions throughout the week.

articles.title: Rochdale Veteran Seeks Justice Following Nuclear Tests
articles.excerpt: John Morris, a Rochdale veteran exposed to nuclear tests in the 1950s, expresses renewed hope for justice following the appointment of Prime Minister Andy Burnham, who supports an independent inquiry.
articles.content_html:
A man from Rochdale who was exposed to nuclear tests in the 1950s has expressed renewed hope for justice following the appointment of Prime Minister Andy Burnham. John Morris, now 88, was 18 when he participated in the tests conducted by the Ministry of Defence at Christmas Island in the Pacific Ocean.

Morris is part of a group of veterans who have lodged a criminal complaint against the Ministry of Defence, claiming they have been denied justice. Many veterans, including Morris, have suffered serious health issues as a result of their exposure to the tests and are calling for an independent inquiry into the matter.

Burnham has previously supported the veterans' cause, stating there is clear evidence of misconduct in public office. He has indicated that he backs a judicial review, which has given Morris and others hope for a resolution to their claims. Morris stated that Burnham's support has provided him with a sense of optimism regarding the pursuit of justice.

The Ministry of Defence has stated that compensation is available through the War Pensions Scheme, but many veterans feel this is insufficient. Morris believes that Burnham's leadership could lead to a faster investigation into their claims, as they seek accountability for the health issues they have endured.

articles.title: Rochdale's Local Plan to Shape Future with Thousands of New Homes
articles.excerpt: Rochdale's Local Plan aims to build nearly 11,000 new homes and transform transport hubs by 2039, with a council meeting scheduled to discuss its next phase.
articles.content_html:
A council meeting on July 28 will discuss the Rochdale Local Plan, which aims to shape the borough's future until 2039. The plan includes the construction of nearly 11,000 new homes and significant changes around transport hubs.

The Local Plan is part of a broader strategy known as Places for Everyone, which aims to deliver around 175,000 homes across Greater Manchester over the next two decades. The plan is expected to attract investment and redevelopment in Rochdale, particularly through the Atom Valley scheme, which aims to create 7,000 new homes and 20,000 jobs.

The Rochdale Rail Corridor Strategy is central to the Local Plan, focusing on transforming land around transport hubs along the Manchester to Leeds railway line. This strategy includes plans for new public realms, community spaces, and improved walking and cycling routes.

The Local Plan also addresses various topics such as climate and energy, economic growth, and sustainable transport, prioritising the growth ambitions of Rochdale and its surrounding areas. The town centre is identified as a key area for regeneration, with recent developments including the £20m redevelopment of the Grade-I listed Rochdale Town Hall, which was completed in 2024. This redevelopment is expected to enhance the town's cultural offerings alongside other projects like the Touchstones Gallery.
